title: FlowConfig
description:
Top-level application configuration structure.

Loaded from `%USERPROFILE%\.config\flow\flow.yml` (see [`config::dirs`](crate::config::dirs) for the full resolution chain including `--config` flag and `FLOW_CONFIG_DIR` env var overrides). Every field has a default, so even an empty YAML file `{}` produces a valid config.

This struct contains **application settings only** — hotkeys, padding, animation, etc. Window classification rules live in a separate file ([`WindowRulesConfig`]) to allow independent editing.

# Example

```yaml super_key: VK_F24 column_width: 960 min_column_width_px: 320 padding: window: 4 up: 0 down: 0 hotkeys: focus_left: Super+H focus_right: Super+L animation: enabled: true duration_ms: 180 easing: ease-out-expo ```

See `docs/spec/04-config-and-persistence.md` for the full schema.

column_width.description: Default column width in pixels. Default: 960.

min_column_width_px.description: Minimum column width in pixels. Columns cannot be resized below this. Default: 320.

minimize_restore.description: Behavior when a minimized tiling window is restored.

super_key.description: The virtual key code treated as the Super/modifier key.

AnimationConfig.description:
Animation configuration for layout transitions.

When disabled, all [`WindowMove`](crate::layout::WindowMove)s are applied instantly (hint set to [`Restore`](crate::layout::AnimationHint::Restore)).

Hotkeys.description:
All hotkey bindings (13 total).

Default keybinds use Vim-style `Super+H/J/K/L` for focus. All defaults are generated via a `default_hotkey!` macro to avoid repetition.

place_above.description: Place window above others in column: default `Super+A`.

MinimizeRestore.description:
Strategy for restoring minimized tiling windows.

- `OriginalSlot` — put the window back where it was before minimize - `RightOfFocused` — insert as a new column to the right of focused - `AppendRight` — append as the rightmost column on the canvas

MinimizeRestoreStrategy.description:
Available minimize restore strategies.

See [`MinimizeRestore`] for the semantics of each variant.

oneOf.description: Put the window back where it was before minimize.
Insert as a new column to the right of focused.
Append as the rightmost column on the canvas.

Padding.description:
Padding configuration in pixels.

Padding is applied during the projection step (see [`projection`](crate::layout::projection)), not stored inside window structs. This means [`ActualEntry`](crate::layout::ActualEntry) rects are the **final HWND rects** — they can be passed directly to `SetWindowPos`.

- `window`: inset around each window within its container cell (visual gap) - `up`: top screen margin so windows don't touch the top edge - `down`: bottom screen margin (e.g., for taskbar clearance)

```text ┌─────────────────── monitor work area ───────────────────┐ │ ↑ padding.up                                            │ │ ┌──────── column cell ────────┐ ┌── next column cell ──┐ │ │ │ ↑ padding.window            │ │                       │ │ │ │ ┌──── window (HWND) ────┐   │ │                       │ │ │ │ │                       │   │ │                       │ │ │ │ └───────────────────────┘   │ │                       │ │ │ │ ↓ padding.window            │ │                       │ │ │ └─────────────────────────────┘ └───────────────────────┘ │ │ ↓ padding.down                                          │ └──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘ ```

down.description: Bottom screen margin (e.g., for taskbar clearance).

up.description: Top screen margin so windows don't touch the top edge.

window.description: Inset around each window within its container cell (visual gap).
